text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's the New Year, Trainer! In this Senior 
year, I will finally take flight to 
Europe!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, to the shrine— Let's go pray to the 
'Gods' for help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relying on God... Apparently, that's what 
Hatsumode translates to in Pearl-speak.
choice_data_list: What about other New Year's terms?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's true. There are all sorts of 
things. Worshipping the first sun, buying 
chaos grab bags...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And best of all, cash. Jewel. US dollars 
are accepted too, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, New Year's money is called 
"Cash Dama" here. Though modest, I decided 
to hand over the envelope I prepared.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for me? Even though I'm not a child, 
you really shouldn't have.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take the New Year's envelope and open 
it. And inside, there was...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Paper...? It really is just plain paper, 
not bills. There's something written on 
it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words written with a brush pen. There was 
only a single phrase—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Prix Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A French Mile GⅠ held in the summer! 
Trainer... look at this!
choice_data_list: Here's New Year's money from me!
Here's a New Year's gift from me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I handed over was the name of the 
European GⅠ race chosen as this year's 
major target.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! You're the absolute best!! What 
an incredible gift! I'm so thrilled, so 
worked up, I just...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohohohohohoho!!!!!! Kyahahahaha!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her excitement skyrocketed so much that 
even her laugh sounded weird. She seems to 
have been that happy with it."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Aiming for the 『Prix Jacques le Marois』 
though... that really is shooting for the 
stars...”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One of the two pinnacle races among French 
Mile GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Winning here will unquestionably establish 
them as a world-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A 1600m race on deep turf is a remarkably 
high hurdle, but...
choice_data_list:
Would something a bit safer have been 
better?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Non! Whatever is lacking, we can make up 
for from now on. And...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We will achieve our dream no matter what! 
We'll show hope to the entire world!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled, first 
things first: praying to the gods for 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Seeking the Pearl and I finished 
our New Year's shrine visit. And then...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An unfamiliar land, France... To get 
results there, we need more than just 
God's grace—we need simulations too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This preparation is in anticipation 
of the French Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should I do during this New 
Year's break?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparing to get used to France. There are 
many things to consider. For example...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
French cuisine! Yes, getting used to their 
diet is more important than anything.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat all kinds of things while we 
have the chance to train our palates! 
Let's cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Um, this is the galette, this is the 
confit, and this is the poêlé...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... I totally *understand* the 
characteristics of French cuisine now...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, don't worry about how it's 
cooked! Food is food! Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as it's delicious, that's enough. 
Now, clear your mind and eat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl devoured the food 
without a second thought. Though she 
gained no culinary knowledge, her vitality 
certainly increased.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Becoming true French natives! Yes, it's 
absolutely vital to fully immerse 
ourselves as local people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's spend this New Year's acting like 
the French!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Hey, Chocolatier! Some tasty 
chocolates, s'il vous plaît?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oui oui, okay, Mont Blanc! Heheh, now I've 
upgraded from bilingual to trilingual!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeking the Pearl, feeling a bit more 
confident. Yet the reason she could 
connect with anyone... was thanks to her 
body language skills."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A Japan-France game showdown! Well, I know 
nothing about how the fighters from that 
country battle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fine! I'll crush you in a battle royale. 
We're holing up at the net cafe, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, what skillful coverage! I wonder if 
this tactic is trending in France?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, grenade! It's a grenade! 
Grandmother taught me many ways to pull 
the rug out from under people!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl learned a variety of 
gameplay techniques. This creative 
approach will surely serve her well in 
races too.
